title: Tectonic (Cronos) money market - post-hack live extractability
closed_reasons: mintGuardianPaused=true and borrowGuardianPaused=true on all 18 markets (block 97,656,545); mintAllowed()/borrowAllowed() revert with 'mint is paused'/'borrow is paused'; mint()/borrow() revert on tUSDC/tCRO/tTONIC
empty-market donation / exchange-rate inflation requires mint -> closed
borrow against manipulated collateral (the Aug-2026 $120.4M exploit class) requires borrow -> closed
oracle feeds are RedStone-style aggregators updated by an owner-only updatePrice(); not spot-manipulable by an unprivileged attacker

2,914 accounts have shortfall ($34,982.96) but their remaining collateral is dust; fork-verified best single liquidation profit ~$0.9 (repay $13.54 -> seize ~$14.4); ~$35k is bad debt with no collateral left
reserves (~$1.92M) and all admin functions (_reduceReserves, caps, CFs, oracle registration, upgrades, unpause) are admin-gated to EOA 0x9e3f42052337e2cF0C3748bCC732430Af3F53f72
key_facts: Live on-chain (block 97,651,394): cash $21,902,513 + borrows $8,423,528 + reserves $1,918,914 (oracle prices); DefiLlama TVL $22.04M
Aug-2026 incident: TONIC pumped ~100x, 364.6T TONIC collateral, $120.4M borrowed across 9 markets, no borrow caps; Cronos rolled back 10,961 blocks, $111.2M reversed, $9.19M gone
Post-hack fix live: TONIC CF cut to 5%, borrow caps set on all markets, mint+borrow paused on all 18
Live oracle anomaly: tTONIC oracle $1.9284e-8 vs VVS USDC/TONIC DEX $8.9418e-9 = +115.6% premium (feed updatedAt current, owner-pushed); tLCRO +2.1%, tCDCBTC +0.7%, tCDCETH +0.5%, all others <0.5%
Liquidations open (liquidateBorrowAllowed=0 for underwater accounts; seizeAllowed=0; closeFactor 0.5; liquidationIncentive 1.10; protocolSeizeShare 2.8%) - but only dust collateral remains
Fork PoC: tUSDC debt -> tVVS collateral liquidation on 0x8e2c707786b55b2c25c9b834d5a2c1fb6d56d395 repays $13.54, seizes $14.4, profit ~$0.9; redeem to VVS succeeds

Adjacent: TectonicStakingPool holds 90.9T TONIC (~$813k at live price), fully backed by 40.39T xTONIC at ~2.25; zero allowances to TCM/router; public tcmPublicAccess cannot move pool funds; owner-gated admin
Cronos sibling forks immaterial: Mimas $31.2k borrowed=0; Agile/CroLend $0; VVS Flawless is a DEX
caveats: Exact extractable liquidation total is computed in CI from on-chain getAccountSnapshot over all 6,530 borrower accounts (subgraph-enumerated); the local subgraph estimate was $5.16 - the honest range is $0-$10 and is dust after gas
Borrower enumeration uses Tectonic's official subgraph (indexed to block 97,652,543); accounts that never emitted Borrow/Repay events are not enumerable, but all debt positions emit Borrow
DefiLlama's 'borrowed' field ($126k) contradicts on-chain borrows ($8.42M); on-chain values used throughout
The TONIC oracle premium would become exploitable within the borrow caps if mint/borrow are unpaused (tTONIC borrow cap ~$47k at oracle price); this is a latent risk, not current E-U
Staking-pool/vault checks are bounded (no source review; behavior verified via selectors, balances, allowances, exchange rate)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live (liquidation dust only) from Tectonic on Cronos: all 18 markets have mint+borrow guardian-paused, oracle feeds are owner-pushed (not manipulable), and the 2,914 underwater accounts hold dust collateral (~$35k is unrecoverable bad debt).
